draft.emotion: focused and steady, bringing a task to its proper close
notes: Takes a direct object in the accusative case, or an infinitive verb (e.g., заканчивать работать — to finish working). For an event ending by itself ('The movie is ending'), use the reflexive заканчиваться.

senses.definition: To bring an activity or task to an end.

examples.text: Я обычно заканчиваю работу в шесть часов.
examples.translation: I usually finish work at six o'clock.
examples.emotion: routine and steady, looking forward to going home

senses.definition: To complete one's studies at a school or university.

examples.text: Она заканчивает университет в этом году.
examples.translation: She is graduating from university this year.
examples.emotion: proud and looking forward to the future

draftBefore.emotion: focused and steady, bringing a task to its proper close
notes: This is the imperfective verb. Use it when you are in the process of finishing something or when you do something regularly.
Do not confuse with закончить, which is the perfective form used when the action is completely done and you want to emphasize the result.

senses.definition: To bring something to an end; to stop doing an activity because it is complete.

examples.text: Я обычно заканчиваю работу в шесть часов.
examples.translation: I usually finish work at six o'clock.
examples.emotion: routine and steady, looking forward to going home

senses.definition: To come to the end of something naturally, or for an event or process to reach its final point.

examples.translation: The movie is coming to an end already.
examples.emotion: noticing the time passing, watching the screen closely

senses.definition: To complete a course of study at a school, university, or institute.

examples.text: Она заканчивает университет в этом году.
examples.translation: She is graduating from the university this year.
examples.emotion: proud and looking forward to the future

faults.quote: To come to the end of something naturally, or for an event
faults.why: Intransitive 'to come to an end' is the reflexive verb заканчиваться, not заканчивать.
Uses the reflexive verb заканчиваться instead of the headword заканчивать.
